company_name: Kyushu Institute of Technology, Center for Microelectronic Systems
semiconductor_relevance: High — the Kyushu Institute of Technology provides essential microfabrication services and infrastructure for semiconductor research and development.
summary: The Kyushu Institute of Technology's Microfabrication Technology Center offers an open innovation environment for semiconductor research, supporting both large corporations and startups. It provides comprehensive microfabrication capabilities, including design, mask creation, wafer processing, and chip assembly, along with operator training and prototyping services.
capabilities: Integrated semiconductor development from design to evaluation
Mask creation and wafer processing equipment
Prototyping services with fast turnaround times

regional_presence.Japan: The center is located in Iizuka City, Fukuoka Prefecture, and serves as a leading semiconductor infrastructure platform in Japan.
